properties.description:
⭐⭐ THE CAUSE IS STRUCTURAL AND IT IS ONE SENTENCE: **`loop_status` computes debt from STRUCTURE, and a friction report is a FACT, so no debt class counts it.**

The classes it computes are: unsurfaced gaps, unanswered questions, unwritten answers, undispositioned drift, unexamined claims, unproven capabilities, unsettled assigned decisions, structural defects, verification status, and export sync. **Not one of them is 'open defect reported from the field'.** A `fact_type: defect` TemporalFact is inert — it is written, it is true, and the one call every session is told to make cannot see it.

So the loop is not broken in the half everyone watches. It is broken in the half nobody measures: **things get IN and nothing brings them OUT.** A month-old friction item and a five-day-old one are equally invisible, and the only mechanism that has ever surfaced one is a human remembering.

═══ CORROBORATION FROM AN INDEPENDENT DIRECTION ═══

`fact:defect-kit-manifest-drift-is-invisible-to-ci` appeared in `detect_defects` on 2026-08-27 as an ORPHAN: *'points at nothing that exists — its subject/target id resolves to no node and it carries no edge either, so the record is about something the design no longer has.'* The structural detector CAN see that the record is dangling. It cannot see that the DEFECT is open. Those are different questions and only the first is asked.

═══ ⚠️ WHY THIS IS THE ROOT AND NOT THE SYMPTOM ═══

Each repeated item has its own local explanation — the instructions are truncated by a client cap, the kit manifest has no CI check, the loop nudge is not installed in that project. Fixing those three fixes those three. **The pattern is that all three survived a month of sessions that each ran `loop_status` and were told the loop was clean of everything it knows how to count.** Fix the three and the fourth will repeat in September.

⭐ AND IT BEARS DIRECTLY ON THE STANDING RULE IT IS FILED AGAINST. `rule:reflow2-is-built-for-other-projects-not-for-itself` makes field use the point. Field use produces friction reports. Friction reports enter the graph and never come out. **The one input the rule says matters most is the one input with no return path.**

═══ ⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH ═══

- **189 open is a RAW COUNT, not a backlog.** Many are surely fixed, and nobody drew the edge — which is the same finding from the other side, not a separate one. How many are genuinely live is UNMEASURED, and this must not be read as '189 outstanding bugs'.
- **`fact_type` is not a reliable filter.** It is an optional free-string property; facts recording a defect without that value are not in the 190, and facts carrying it that are really observations are. The number is indicative, not exact.
- **No remedy is asserted**, and the obvious one — add a debt class — has a real counter: a count that can never reach zero becomes wallpaper, which is the failure this project has already found three times. Options are open in `dec:idea-what-makes-a-field-report-owed`.
properties.name: ROOT CAUSE of the repeats: capture works and NOTHING MAKES IT OWED — 190 defect-facts, 189 open, 8 INVALIDATES edges in the whole design, and no loop_status class counts any of them
properties.statement: MEASURED 2026-08-28 over the committed export. THREE OF THE FOUR items in the 2026-08-27 field report are marked 'still true' and 'same as 2026-08-18'. They were all CAPTURED — `fact:defect-the-served-instructions-put-their-standing-rules-where-a-client-cap-deletes-them` (2026-08-15), `fact:defect-kit-manifest-drift-is-invisible-to-ci` (2026-08-07), `fact:defect-an-absent-kit-is-unreportable-while-a-stale-one-is-detected` (2026-08-15), and `ver:kit-manifest-agrees` whose own name records the friction as dating to 2026-07-25 and says 'unwritten'. So the capture half of the loop WORKS and has worked for a month. || THE NUMBERS: 190 TemporalFacts carry `fact_type: defect`. 189 have no inbound INVALIDATES — nothing claims to have answered them. 77 of those reach ONE EDGE OR NONE, so they appear in no impact analysis and cannot be reached by traversal from anything. The whole design holds 8 INVALIDATES edges in total.
